rules.statement: A person cannot obtain a writ of mandamus to compel the Tea Export Controller to issue coupons in respect of certain tea estates where the person failed to appeal to the Board of Appeal under section 12(4) of the Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: Where a person who is aggrieved by a decision of the Controller fails to appeal to the Board of appeal under section 12 (4) of the Ordinance, the remedy by way of mandamus is not open to him.

meta.parties: The Bank of Chettinad v. Tea Export Controller
